notes: Added: online Rooms - browse public rooms, create public or private rooms with a password or PIN; team chat (T), all chat (Y), quick radio (Z) and map pings (G); minimap radar, colour-blind team colours, and a map vote or rematch after every match; spawn protection for 2.5 s after every spawn, in all modes | Fixed: bots no longer jump constantly and only hop over real ledges; a bot added in the lobby is now visible to everyone right away | Changed: Dune Run rebuilt with a real dust2-style layout (long, short, mid, tunnels)

added: First public build: 3D team shooter with cards, bots and online play
In-game updater with short patch notes
Crouch on Ctrl
New map: Frost Yard (compact snowy arena)
Join accepts a host name, e.g. cardarena.tr1zoru.ro
fixed: Play vs Bots started a 3v3 when you chose 1v3
Settings window keeps the same size on every tab
No update server error before the first release

added: Join remembers your servers (recent list, no more 127.0.0.1 default)
Spectate a living teammate after you die
The game checks for updates by itself, no need to press Check
fixed: Changing a setting no longer shrinks a maximized window
changed: Homing is a subtle nudge toward enemies near your aim

added: Gun Game mode - every kill gives the next weapon, the last one is the sword
17 new weapons (pistol, SMG, shotgun, sniper, rocket and grenade launcher, minigun, railgun, sword and more)
bots know how to use every weapon
fixed: switching camera while spectating a teammate no longer needs a click
changed: Play vs Bots and the lobby keep the same size when you change the mode

added: Buy Menu mode - earn money, buy weapons in a 10 s buy phase (key B), bots buy too
sniper scope like CS 1.6 - right click cycles zoom, zoom more, scope off
NO SCOPE message when you kill with the sniper without scoping in

fixed: update check now runs every 3 minutes and bypasses caches, so new versions show up by themselves
sharper snow and rock textures at a distance, smoother edges (anti-aliasing)

added: Show FPS option in Settings > Display
fixed: much sharper wall, floor and ground textures on both maps (2K textures, detail layer, anisotropic filtering)
when spectating a teammate you now see their health and weapon
shadows no longer show visible steps at a distance (smoother cascades, bigger shadow map)

added: Pause menu has an All settings button (general, crosshair, display)
Graphics settings tab with presets (Low, Medium, High, Ultra), shadows, anti-aliasing, texture filtering and effects
changed: New look for all menus, lobby, buy menu and HUD (Hazard Orange / Tactical)
New fonts (Chakra Petch and Barlow) and square, flat panels
menus no longer run the GPU at full speed (60 fps cap in menus)

added: new realistic soldier characters with team-colored helmet and vest, and real animations
changed: weapons are now held in the hand of the character

added: weapon cards - pick any of the 17 weapons as a card in Cards mode
fixed: bots no longer get stuck inside the middle house on Frost Yard (they now follow a navigation mesh)
muzzle flash of other players is no longer visible through walls

changed: card offers get weaker when your team is far ahead and better after a comeback win
weapon cards keep your magazine at 3, only bullet cards add rounds
+50% damage cards cost 1 bullet (magazine never below 1)
weapon cards are much rarer and at most one weapon card is offered at a time

added: Your bonuses panel - all accumulated card effects on the card pick screen and while holding TAB
distinct sounds for every weapon, reloads, impacts, hit marker, kills, round stingers and footsteps
bullet impacts and sparks on walls, camera recoil, explosion shake, damage direction indicator, low-health vignette
changed: soldiers hold rifles with two hands, lean with their aim, recoil when firing; better helmet and vest
bots avoid each other, jump on crates, take cover when hurt, hold or push by weapon and react to being shot

fixed: other soldiers no longer stretch and grow over the course of a match

added: 4 new maps - Aim Arena, Dune Run (dust2-style), Old Town and Cargo Docks
climb onto crates with jump + crouch, with a hint when a ledge is climbable
rocket jumps - explosions push players
scoreboard on TAB in every mode and match stats with MVP on the end screen
Controls settings - rebind keys, field of view, scoped sensitivity, invert Y, toggle crouch
card pick timer (15 s, random card if time runs out) and Legendary cards
fixed: better aim online - the server rewinds players for sniper, railgun and laser shots
changed: losing team now picks cards too, with weaker offers

added: online Rooms - browse public rooms, create public or private rooms with a password or PIN
team chat (T), all chat (Y), quick radio (Z) and map pings (G)
minimap radar, colour-blind team colours, and a map vote or rematch after every match
spawn protection for 2.5 s after every spawn, in all modes
fixed: bots no longer jump constantly and only hop over real ledges
a bot added in the lobby is now visible to everyone right away
changed: Dune Run rebuilt with a real dust2-style layout (long, short, mid, tunnels)
